answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a lottery picks 5 falcon-eyed peers to audit an agent's work, posting the trail on an open ledge for re-check. A trellis of cross-checks links each auditor to the agent checked, so colluding pairs surface as repeated links and are excluded. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 audits at 200 POA each, 200,000 POA while an honest agent pays one 200 POA deposit and keeps its share undiluted.
